يحتاجوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَاجُوا (yaḥtājū) /jaħ.taː.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
# يُحْتَاجُوا (yuḥtājū) /juħ.taː.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
